name: Force Barrier (Recharge 5–6)
description: The creature magically creates a wall of translucent, golden force within 90 feet of itself. The wall lasts for 1 minute or until the creature uses this action again. The barrier can be a vertical or horizontal plane up to 30 feet on a side or a 10-foot-radius hemispherical dome with a floor. The wall provides total cover. It has AC 17, 30 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
